payload_provenance.note: The committed .hex payloads predate the formal_o1_ir_no_asm_opt profile. They were produced by a compiler entry point that ran a single pass (concretize_context_eval) with no target-safety gate and no assembly finalizer; that entry point no longer exists in the tree. Regeneration under the target profile is blocked because the evaluation does not finish; see .agent-files/tasks/TASK_064.md. Until it is unblocked, these files are a regression baseline against their own 2026-05-28 values, not evidence about the current compiler.
